purpose: 在已冻结源预算内实际读取新对象，保存请求前选择与原字节
program:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,datetime,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path.cwd()
out=base/'reports/research/510300_electricity_composition_event_source_contract_v1'
url='https://fjb.nea.gov.cn/dtyw/hyxx/202411/t20241121_272619.html'
tz=datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))
selected={'url':url,'selected_at':datetime.datetime.now(tz).isoformat(),'reason':'两次已登记官方查询返回的国家能源局福建监管办公室全国原通报转载，统计期固定2024-10，非福建省量，未重试E41失败根对象','raw_GET_budget':2,'this_GET_number':1,'no_auth':True,'no_retry':True,'allow_redirects':False,'first_vintage_authenticated':False,'query_file_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'官方域名两次查询_完整结果.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(out/'新原转载对象选择_请求前.json').write_text(json.dumps(selected,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
sess=requests.Session()
sess.trust_env=False
sess.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'text/html,application/xhtml+xml'})
receipt=dict(selected)
receipt['requested_at']=datetime.datetime.now(tz).isoformat()
try:
    response=sess.get(url,timeout=(10,25),allow_redirects=False)
    body=response.content
    (out/'raw').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (out/'raw/nea_fujian_national_oct2024.html').write_bytes(body)
    receipt.update({'http_status':response.status_code,'response_url':response.url,'bytes':len(body),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),'content_type':response.headers.get('Content-Type'),'body_saved':'raw/nea_fujian_national_oct2024.html'})
    if response.status_code==200:
        soup=BeautifulSoup(body.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
        for node in soup(['script','style']):
            node.decompose()
        paragraphs=[p.get_text(' ',strip=True) for p in soup.find_all(['h1','p'])]
        candidates=[p for p in paragraphs if any(s in p for s in ['全社会用电量','2024-11-21','2024年10月份','11月20日'])]
        receipt['readable_candidate_paragraphs']=candidates
        (out/'原转载可读全文.txt').write_text(soup.get_text('\n',strip=True),encoding='utf-8')
except Exception as e:
    receipt.update({'http_status':'NOT_RECEIVED','error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)})
finally:
    sess.close()
receipt['finished_at']=datetime.datetime.now(tz).isoformat()
(out/'新原转载GET_实际收件.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
